evals.prompt: Add the shadcn dialog component to the project.
evals.expected_output: A dialog.tsx file in src/components/ui/ using the correct #/ alias, with the eslint disable comment at the top, using the radix-ui unified package, and no lucide-react imports.
expectations: All imports use the '#/' alias (no '@/' alias anywhere in the file)
The file imports from 'radix-ui' (not from '@radix-ui/react-dialog' or similar scoped packages)
The file starts with the comment '/* eslint-disable import/consistent-type-specifier-style */'
The file contains no import from 'lucide-react'
Each major sub-component (DialogOverlay, DialogContent, DialogTitle, etc.) has a data-slot attribute on its root element
The cn() utility is imported from '#/lib/utils'
All exports are named exports (no default export)

evals.prompt: Create a SearchInput component — an input with a search icon on the left and a clear (X) button that appears when there's text. It should be reusable and accept a standard input onChange handler.
evals.expected_output: A SearchInput.tsx file in src/components/ (PascalCase) that uses shadcn Input, the #/ alias, @hugeicons/react for icons (not lucide-react), includes data-slot='search-input' on the root, and follows the CVA pattern if it has variants.
expectations: The file is named SearchInput.tsx (PascalCase), not search-input.tsx
All imports use the '#/' alias (no '@/' alias anywhere in the file)
Icons are imported from '@hugeicons/react' and/or '@hugeicons/core-free-icons', not from 'lucide-react'
The file starts with '/* eslint-disable import/consistent-type-specifier-style */'
The root element has data-slot='search-input'
The component accepts an onChange prop typed as React.ComponentProps<'input'>['onChange'] or equivalent
The component is exported as a named export (not default)
The clear button only appears when there is text (conditional rendering based on value)

evals.prompt: Add a 'warning' variant to the existing Button component in src/components/ui/button.tsx.
evals.expected_output: The button.tsx file updated with a 'warning' variant that follows the same opacity-layered pattern as the 'destructive' variant (tinted background, matching text, hover darkens, dark mode adjusts), without breaking any existing variants.
expectations: The warning variant uses an opacity-layered Tailwind pattern (e.g. bg-amber-500/10 or bg-yellow-500/10), matching the destructive variant's style
The warning variant includes dark mode classes (dark:bg-... dark:hover:bg-... or similar)
All 6 original variants (default, outline, secondary, ghost, destructive, link) are still present and unchanged
The file still starts with '/* eslint-disable import/consistent-type-specifier-style */'
No new imports were added (warning doesn't require any new dependencies)
The buttonVariants export includes the new 'warning' value in its type
